title: Intrinsic DNA codes govern distinct modes of nucleosome-transcription factor interactions
authors: Christopher W. Carson; Sheethal Umesh Nagalakshmi; Image Adhikari; Julia M. Freewoman; Joseph R. Pizzi; Prakyat Prakash; Feng Cui
one_liner_zh: 该文研究DNA序列编码的核小体模式与转录因子结合的关联，虽聚焦核小体-TF互作而非直接TF-DNA结合建模，但涉及TF结合位点与DNA序列特征，方法上无AI或物理模拟，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作且对TF-DNA研究有参考价值。
abstract: The interplay between transcription factors (TFs) and nucleosomes is central to gene regulation, yet most studies adopt a protein-centric perspective that largely overlooks DNA sequence contributions. Here, we identify four distinct nucleosomal DNA classes, including the canonical WW/SS pattern (W = A/T, S = G/C). All four nucleosome types are widespread across the human genome both in vivo and in vitro . Nucleosomes sharing the same pattern are rotationally in phase, whereas different patterns exhibit specific rotational offsets, revealing distinct DNA-encoded codes for nucleosome positioning. Analysis of 747 TFs across eukaryotes shows that the WW/SS and anti-WW/SS patterns are strongly associated with TF binding in chromatin. Differences in the proportions of these two patterns, quantified as ΔNPS values, correlate closely with in vitro nucleosome occupancy. Integrating ΔNPS with in vivo nucleosome occupancy uncovers four distinct modes of nucleosome-TF interaction and provides new insight into nucleosome-depleted regions around TF binding sites.
abstract_zh: 转录因子（TFs）与核小体之间的相互作用是基因调控的核心，然而大多数研究采用以蛋白质为中心的视角，在很大程度上忽视了DNA序列的贡献。在此，我们识别出四种不同的核小体DNA类别，包括经典的WW/SS模式（W = A/T，S = G/C）。所有四种核小体类型在人类基因组中广泛存在，无论是在体内还是体外。共享相同模式的核小体在旋转上同相，而不同模式则表现出特定的旋转偏移，揭示了核小体定位的不同DNA编码规则。对真核生物中747个TFs的分析表明，WW/SS和反WW/SS模式与染色质中的TF结合密切相关。这两种模式比例的差异，以ΔNPS值量化，与体外核小体占有率紧密相关。将ΔNPS与体内核小体占有率整合，揭示了核小体-TF相互作用的四种不同模式，并为TF结合位点周围的核小体缺失区域提供了新见解。
